context_for_next_testing_agent: 20-level gamification fully tested. Key API details: (1) GET /api/intelligence/survival-clock - returns effectiveFunds, monthlyMandatoryExpense, survivalDays, level (NEEDS ATTENTION/BUILDING/COMFORTABLE/SECURE/CHAMPION), fundBreakdown with instant/semiLiquid/marketable/locked categories. FDs counted at 90% in semi-liquid. (2) GET /api/intelligence/control-score - returns finalScore (0-100), grade (A-E), breakdown with 4 pillars (savingsRate, emiLoad, safetyBuffer, incomeConsistency) each having score, max, label, help text. (3) GET /api/intelligence/behavior-alerts - returns alerts array with type/severity/message. (4) GET /api/gamification/profile - returns 20 levels in allLevels array with stages (begin/learn/grow/control/expand/master/legend/freedom), 24 achievements with categories, xpRules array, maxBadgesUnlocked metric. (5) GET /api/gamification/challenges - returns available (with explainer, difficulty), active, completed arrays. (6) POST /api/gamification/challenges/{code}/join - joins challenge. (7) DELETE /api/gamification/challenges/{id}/leave - abandons challenge using UUID id not code. (8) POST /api/gamification/process - processes weekly gamification, returns xpEarned, totalXP, newLevel with allLevels.
